build_configuration: CUDA12.8 / MSVC Release / compute7.5 / C++20 / no fast math
source_normalization: CRLF to LF only; source bytes and Python code otherwise unchanged.
dispatch: Only total>16384, ordered visits>=8192, satellites<=16384; epoch chunks max(1,4096/n_sat), further bounded by existing mirror capacity. All other paths retained.
arithmetic: Host scheduling only. Existing GPU functions, full candidates, FP64 arithmetic, right-first ordinals and tie rules retained; finalize writes disjoint original output ranges.
working_memory: Winner scratch<=640KiB (usually160KiB); existing mirror scratch<=32MiB, per-call refreshed, reused sequentially.

device_code.normalization: Instruction bodies with whitespace collapsed only; offsets, encodings and attributes retained.

method: Own process pinned to one allowed CPU, normal priority; sequential whole calls; alternating build order each repetition and round; nonexclusive host

performance_gate: At least 5% complete public trace reduction in the target large batches, consistent rounds, bit-identical outputs and no substantial cold/control regression. Broader validation and sanitizers required before adoption.
